---
title: v3.1.3 — Structured Install State and Consistent JSON Formatting
---

## Overview

Refactor the macOS and Windows installer state into a structured file manifest with consistent, human-readable JSON output.

## Highlights

- Store each managed file as an object containing its logical path and SHA-256 digest, preserving the seven root-level state fields.
- Write deterministic two-space Pretty JSON with UTF-8 without BOM, LF line endings and path-ordered manifest entries on both platforms.
- Validate JSON structure and content independently of whitespace and field or manifest order. Reject duplicate keys, invalid types, unsafe paths, invalid hashes and duplicate file entries.
- Preserve managed-file integrity checks, physical Host entries, Global Instructions handling, installation locking and transaction recovery without requiring additional third-party runtime dependencies.
- Update native installer regression tests, release installation and downloader E2E checks, installed Host simulations and installer documentation.

## Compatibility

The previous string-array install-state.json manifest is not supported by this installer. Existing installations using that format are rejected without modifying their contents; no automatic migration or cleanup is provided. Back up and manually handle the previous managed installation according to the installation documentation before installing the new format.
